items.titleZh: 抗突变型瓜氨酸化波形蛋白抗体在类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺疾病中的诊断和临床意义：一项范围综述
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺疾病（RA-ILD）是类风湿关节炎（RA）最严重的关节外表现之一，需要可靠的生物标志物用于早期检测。本范围综述综合了关于抗突变型瓜氨酸化波形蛋白（anti-MCV）抗体在RA-ILD患者中诊断性能和临床关联的现有证据。在PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus和Cochrane图书馆进行了全面的文献检索。经过系统筛选，两项观察性研究符合预定的纳入标准。两项纳入研究均报告，与无肺部受累的RA患者相比，RA-ILD患者的anti-MCV阳性率和/或血清水平显著更高。具体而言，一项研究确定了anti-MCV阳性与RA-ILD之间的独立关联，而另一项研究则显示了anti-MCV滴度与肺功能损害以及疾病活动标志物之间的显著相关性。然而，各研究在检测平台、阳性阈值和诊断截断值方面存在显著异质性，这限制了结果之间的直接可比性。尽管anti-MCV抗体代表了RA-ILD有前景的候选生物标志物，但现有证据仍然有限，不足以确定其明确的诊断、预后或致病意义。因此，有必要进行更大规模、前瞻性、多中心的研究，采用标准化的anti-MCV检测方案，以严格评估这些抗体在RA-ILD管理中的临床效用。

items.title: Beyond the Surface: Antinuclear Antibodies in Rheumatoid Arthritis-Experiences from a Single-Center, Cross-Sectional Observational Study.
items.abstract: Background: Antinuclear antibodies (ANA) can be detected in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and pose many diagnostic challenges, especially when RA presents an atypical course and requires differentiation from other systemic connective tissue diseases (sCTDs). This study assessed ANA fluorescence patterns and immunoblot profiles, as well as the relationships between ANA titers, antibody expression intensity, and markers of disease activity in patients with RA. Methods : This single-center, cross-sectional, observational study included 81 RA patients (53 ANA-positive) meeting the 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria. ANA titers and fluorescence patterns were assessed using indirect immunofluorescence. Anti-extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) autoantibody profiles and expression intensity were assessed using immunoblot analysis. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were obtained. Spearman's rank correlation coefficient was used to analyze the relationship between ANA titers and selected variables. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with ANA positivity. Results : The cohort consisted primarily of women (86.4%) with moderate disease activity. ANA fluorescence patterns were heterogeneous, with nucleolar and homogeneous patterns most frequently observed. Immunoblot analysis also revealed diverse autoantibody profiles without a clearly dominant specificity. Ro-52, SS-A, and Sm antibodies were detected more frequently, although their prevalence remained relatively low. No statistically significant correlations were found between ANA titers and inflammatory markers, serological parameters, or disease activity indices. Conclusions : RA patients with positive ANA demonstrated marked immunological heterogeneity, without concomitant symptoms of sCTD. A positive result in RA may reflect generalized immune dysregulation rather than a distinct clinical subtype. Further studies with larger cohorts are needed to clarify the clinical significance of ANAs in rheumatoid arthritis.

items.title: Serum immune profiling suggests overlap between IBD patients with joint complaints and patients with spondyloarthritis.
items.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and spondyloarthritis (SpA) are strongly associated, and joint complaints are common in patients with IBD. However, it remains unclear whether joint complaints in IBD merely reflect non-specific symptoms, or whether they are associated with systemic immune features overlapping with SpA. Using a proximity extension assay, 92 inflammation-related proteins were quantified in serum samples of patients from two cohorts: (i) IBD patients without (n = 100) and with joint complaints (n = 155; of whom 15 with SpA), and (ii) 169 patients with chronic back pain of unknown origin at the rheumatology outpatient clinic, where diagnosis of SpA was confirmed (n = 85) or rejected after 2 years of follow-up. Serum samples were collected at baseline. IBD patients without joint complaints from cohort (i) and confirmed axSpA patients from cohort (ii) showed distinct serum immune profiles, with 20 differentially abundant proteins. Among IBD patients with joint complaints, formal SpA diagnosis had limited additional impact on the serum immune profile, with only three differentially abundant proteins between those with and without SpA. Similarly, among patients with chronic back pain, serum immune profiles were largely concordant irrespective of subsequent axSpA diagnosis. Importantly, IBD patients with joint complaints differed from IBD patients without joint complaints, and several proteins increased in this comparison overlapped with proteins increased in axSpA. Joint complaints in IBD are associated with a modest but detectable shift in the circulating immune profile, partly overlapping with axSpA-associated proteins. In contrast, formal SpA diagnosis adds limited additional serum-protein separation among patients who already have joint symptoms. These findings suggest that joint complaints in IBD may mark a biologically relevant subgroup beyond current SpA classification, and support longitudinal studies to determine whether this subgroup has distinct clinical trajectories or treatment responses.

items.titleZh: 血清免疫谱分析提示伴有关节症状的IBD患者与脊柱关节炎患者存在重叠
items.abstractZh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）和脊柱关节炎（SpA）密切相关，关节症状在IBD患者中常见。然而，尚不清楚IBD患者的关节症状是否仅反映非特异性症状，还是与SpA重叠的系统性免疫特征相关。使用邻近延伸分析技术，对两个队列患者的血清样本中92种炎症相关蛋白进行了定量：（i）无关节症状的IBD患者（n=100）和有关节症状的IBD患者（n=155；其中15例患有SpA），以及（ii）风湿病门诊中169名原因不明的慢性背痛患者，其中SpA诊断在2年随访后得到确认（n=85）或排除。血清样本在基线时采集。来自队列（i）的无关节症状IBD患者和来自队列（ii）的确诊axSpA患者显示出不同的血清免疫谱，有20种差异丰度蛋白。在有关节症状的IBD患者中，正式的SpA诊断对血清免疫谱的额外影响有限，SpA患者与非SpA患者之间仅有3种差异丰度蛋白。同样，在慢性背痛患者中，无论后续axSpA诊断如何，血清免疫谱基本一致。重要的是，有关节症状的IBD患者与无关节症状的IBD患者存在差异，且这种比较中增加的几种蛋白与axSpA中增加的蛋白重叠。IBD患者的关节症状与循环免疫谱的适度但可检测的变化相关，部分与axSpA相关蛋白重叠。相比之下，在已有关节症状的患者中，正式的SpA诊断仅增加有限的额外血清蛋白分离。这些发现表明，IBD患者的关节症状可能标志着超越当前SpA分类的生物学相关亚组，并支持纵向研究以确定该亚组是否具有不同的临床轨迹或治疗反应。

items.title: Integrative analysis of FAERS, network toxicology, and Mendelian randomization identifies potential targets in paclitaxel-associated systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a rare and complex autoimmune disease characterized by fibrosis of the skin and internal organs as well as vascular abnormalities. Studies have suggested that paclitaxel may induce adverse reactions resembling systemic sclerosis; however, the underlying mechanisms remain not fully understood. We retrieved reports of paclitaxel-associated SSc from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Potential shared targets between paclitaxel and SSc were identified through network toxicology analysis. Mendelian randomization (MR) was then used to explore associations between these targets and SSc susceptibility. Disproportionality analyses demonstrated significant safety signals linking paclitaxel with SSc, scleroderma, and scleroderma-like reactions. A total of 76 overlapping targets were identified between paclitaxel and SSc. Based on expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) from the IEU OpenGWAS database, MR analysis suggested 11 targets potentially associated with SSc susceptibility. Functional enrichment analyses revealed that these genes were involved in oxidative stress response, regulation of cell death, lipid metabolism, and apoptosis. Among them, AKT1 and BCL2 were highlighted as central nodes in the protein-protein interaction network, representing candidate targets for further investigation. Molecular docking simulations provided exploratory computational evidence of potential interactions, which do not confirm functional or mechanistic roles. Overall, this study systematically explored potential molecular targets related to paclitaxel-associated SSc and provides hypothesis-generating insights that may guide future mechanistic studies and risk assessment strategies.

items.titleZh: 整合FAERS、网络毒理学和孟德尔随机化分析确定紫杉醇相关系统性硬化症的潜在靶点
items.abstractZh: 系统性硬化症（SSc）是一种罕见且复杂的自身免疫性疾病，以皮肤和内脏器官纤维化以及血管异常为特征。研究表明紫杉醇可能诱发类似系统性硬化症的不良反应，但其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。我们从FDA不良事件报告系统（FAERS）中检索了紫杉醇相关SSc的报告。通过网络毒理学分析确定了紫杉醇与SSc之间的潜在共享靶点。随后使用孟德尔随机化（MR）探讨这些靶点与SSc易感性之间的关联。不成比例分析显示紫杉醇与SSc、硬皮病和硬皮病样反应之间存在显著的安全信号。共鉴定出紫杉醇与SSc之间的76个重叠靶点。基于IEU OpenGWAS数据库的表达数量性状位点（eQTL），MR分析提示11个靶点可能与SSc易感性相关。功能富集分析显示这些基因参与氧化应激反应、细胞死亡调控、脂质代谢和凋亡。其中，AKT1和BCL2被突出显示为蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络中的中心节点，代表进一步研究的候选靶点。分子对接模拟提供了潜在相互作用的探索性计算证据，但未确认功能或机制作用。总体而言，本研究系统探索了紫杉醇相关SSc的潜在分子靶点，并提供了产生假说的见解，可能指导未来的机制研究和风险评估策略。

items.title: Targeting the synovial engine: next-generation engineered immune cells to eradicate pathogenic FLS in rheumatoid arthritis, with safety-first, selective designs.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and associated inflammatory arthritides are characterized by chronic synovial inflammation that drives destructive pannus formation, eroding cartilage and bone. Current therapies (csDMARDs, bDMARDs, and tsDMARDs) target immune cells and cytokine pathways but yield low rates of full remission, and many patients with residual synovitis continue to damage their joints. Fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS) have emerged as key tumor-like mediators of RA. In the inflamed synovium, they expand, resist apoptosis, and secrete pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and proteases that sustain disease. Directly killing and/or reprogramming these pathogenic FLS is a promising complementary strategy. Recent advances in engineered cell therapies enable specific targeting of stromal cells. In this review, we will discuss novel CAR-based immune cells (CAR-T, CAR-NK, or CAR-macrophages) engineered to target FLS-specific antigens (e.g., fibroblast activation protein) and induce elimination or modulation of FLS. We advocate a primary "safety-first" translational roadmap that integrates features such as transient CAR expression, safety switches, hypoxia-responsive CAR constructs, and localized (intra-articular) delivery to enhance efficacy while avoiding systemic toxicity. Targeted cellular therapies based on this technology may reshape RA therapy as we know it, dismantling the synovial inflammation "engine" with precision and control.

items.title: Case Report: A "visceral vasculitis storm" in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: simultaneous enteritis, ureteritis, and splenic infarction in a pediatric patient.
items.abstract: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) is a multi-system autoimmune disease. Although lupus enteritis is a recognized manifestation of mesenteric vasculitis, lupus ureteritis is rare. The simultaneous occurrence of both, termed a "visceral vasculitis storm," poses a significant diagnostic challenge. Clinicians often struggle to differentiate primary ureteritis from secondary mechanical compression caused by intestinal edema (the "monistic" view). A 16-year-old girl with a history of transient ptosis and positive ANA/dsDNA results 4 months prior to the current presentation, presented with abdominal pain, fever, and transient dysuria. Initial outpatient CT revealed bilateral hydroureteronephrosis. During hospitalization, the patient's condition deteriorated despite antibiotic therapy. A repeat contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) demonstrated the classic "target sign" in the bowel wall, splenic infarction, and crucially, distinct ureteral wall enhancement. Laboratory findings showed a "high CRP/low PCT" dissociation and a markedly elevated D-Dimer (13.74 μg/mL). The diagnosis was revised to SLE with diffuse visceral vasculitis. The patient responded rapidly to methylprednisolone pulse therapy and IVIG, followed by maintenance therapy with Cyclophosphamide and the dual BLyS/APRIL inhibitor Telitacicept. This case highlights that ureteral wall enhancement on CECT can serve as a potentially useful radiologic clue for primary lupus ureteritis. Recognizing the "visceral vasculitis storm" is essential to avoid the pitfalls of diagnostic monism and to initiate aggressive immunosuppressive therapy promptly to prevent irreversible organ damage.

items.titleZh: 病例报告：系统性红斑狼疮中的“内脏血管炎风暴”——一例儿童患者同时出现肠炎、输尿管炎和脾梗死
items.abstractZh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种多系统自身免疫性疾病。虽然狼疮性肠炎是肠系膜血管炎的公认表现，但狼疮性输尿管炎罕见。两者同时发生，称为“内脏血管炎风暴”，构成了重大的诊断挑战。临床医生常常难以区分原发性输尿管炎与由肠水肿引起的继发性机械性压迫（“一元论”观点）。一名16岁女孩，在本次就诊前4个月有短暂性上睑下垂史且ANA/dsDNA阳性，表现为腹痛、发热和一过性排尿困难。初始门诊CT显示双侧肾盂输尿管积水。住院期间，尽管使用抗生素治疗，患者病情恶化。重复增强CT（CECT）显示肠壁典型的“靶征”、脾梗死，以及关键性的输尿管壁明显强化。实验室检查显示“高CRP/低PCT”分离现象和D-二聚体显著升高（13.74 μg/mL）。诊断修正为SLE伴弥漫性内脏血管炎。患者对甲泼尼龙冲击治疗和IVIG反应迅速，随后使用环磷酰胺和双重BLyS/APRIL抑制剂泰它西普进行维持治疗。本病例强调，CECT上的输尿管壁强化可作为原发性狼疮性输尿管炎的一个潜在有用的放射学线索。识别“内脏血管炎风暴”对于避免一元论诊断陷阱并及时启动积极的免疫抑制治疗以防止不可逆的器官损伤至关重要。

items.title: Case Report: IgG4-related disease presenting with prominent oculomotor nerve palsy.
items.abstract: Immunoglobulin G4-related disease (IgG4-RD) is a systemic fibroinflammatory disorder that uncommonly involves cranial nerves. Oculomotor nerve palsy as the predominant manifestation of IgG4-RD is exceptionally rare and may elude timely diagnosis due to nonspecific symptoms. A 76-year-old man presented with a two-month history of bilateral plantar numbness and pain, followed by nausea, vomiting, and headache. The patient was hospitalized twice: first in August 2025 in the Department of Hematology, and subsequently in October 2025 in the Department of Rheumatology and Immunology. Laboratory evaluation revealed markedly elevated immunoglobulins, prompting a comprehensive workup including bone marrow aspiration, positron emission tomography-computed tomography (PET-CT), and lymph node biopsy. Histopathology demonstrated reactive lymphoid hyperplasia with abundant IgG4 + plasma cell infiltration (IgG4+ > 100 cells/HPF; IgG4/IgG ratio >40%), which established the diagnosis of IgG4-RD according to the 2019 ACR/EULAR classification criteria. During the second hospitalization, the patient developed right ptosis and diplopia, and neurological examination confirmed isolated right oculomotor nerve palsy. Contrast-enhanced brain MRI showed no structural abnormalities, and CTA, along with CSF analysis, excluded alternative etiologies such as aneurysm, neoplasm, or infection. Treatment with intravenous methylprednisolone (40 mg daily) followed by oral mycophenolate mofetil (500 mg twice daily) led to significant clinical improvement of oculomotor palsy within 4 months, with normalization of serum IgG4 levels (from a peak of 74.3 g/L to 8.94 g/L at follow-up) and reduction of inflammatory markers. IgG4-RD should be considered in the differential diagnosis of unexplained cranial neuropathies, even in the absence of radiographic abnormalities. This case highlights that neurological recovery may be gradual and require sustained immunosuppression, and underscores the importance of multidisciplinary collaboration in managing atypical manifestations of IgG4-RD.

items.titleZh: 病例报告：以显著动眼神经麻痹为表现的IgG4相关疾病
items.abstractZh: 免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病（IgG4-RD）是一种系统性纤维炎症性疾病，较少累及颅神经。以动眼神经麻痹为主要表现的IgG4-RD极为罕见，且因症状非特异性而可能延误诊断。一名76岁男性患者出现双侧足底麻木和疼痛两个月，随后出现恶心、呕吐和头痛。患者两次住院：首次于2025年8月在血液科，随后于2025年10月在风湿免疫科。实验室检查显示免疫球蛋白显著升高，促使进行包括骨髓穿刺、正电子发射断层扫描-计算机断层扫描（PET-CT）和淋巴结活检在内的全面检查。组织病理学显示反应性淋巴样增生伴大量IgG4+浆细胞浸润（IgG4+ > 100个细胞/HPF；IgG4/IgG比值>40%），根据2019年ACR/EULAR分类标准确诊为IgG4-RD。第二次住院期间，患者出现右眼上睑下垂和复视，神经系统检查证实为孤立性右侧动眼神经麻痹。增强脑MRI未见结构异常，CTA及CSF分析排除了动脉瘤、肿瘤或感染等其他病因。静脉注射甲泼尼龙（每日40 mg）后口服吗替麦考酚酯（每日两次，每次500 mg）治疗，动眼神经麻痹在4个月内显著改善，血清IgG4水平恢复正常（从峰值74.3 g/L降至随访时的8.94 g/L），炎症标志物降低。对于不明原因的颅神经病变，即使无影像学异常，也应考虑IgG4-RD的鉴别诊断。本病例强调神经功能恢复可能缓慢且需要持续免疫抑制，并突出了多学科协作在处理IgG4-RD非典型表现中的重要性。

items.title: A Practical Anthropometric Model Incorporating Calf Circumference to Estimate Appendicular Lean Mass in Women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
items.abstract: Accurate assessment of appendicular lean mass (ALM), an essential component for evaluating sarcopenia and nutritional status, typically requires dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA); however, its widespread clinical application is limited by cost and accessibility. This study aimed to develop a simple anthropometry-based equation for estimating ALM in women with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and to compare its predictive performance with existing models. This cross-sectional study included 92 female patients with SLE. A multiple regression model was developed, incorporating height, body weight, calf circumference (CC), and age. Model performance was internally validated using five-fold cross-validation, and agreement with DXA-measured ALM was assessed using out-of-fold predictions. The diagnostic performance for detecting low skeletal muscle mass index (SMI) was also evaluated and compared with previously published equations (Hwang and Santos). The predicted ALM showed good correlation with measured ALM (R 2 = 0.76) and moderate agreement (Lin's concordance correlation coefficient [CCC] = 0.829), with a root mean square error of 1.38 kg. Sensitivity and specificity for detecting low SMI were 65.0% and 88.9%, respectively. The proposed equation demonstrated comparable or superior performance (CCC: Hwang 0.782; Santos 0.672) and may serve as a practical tool for estimating ALM in female patients with SLE.

items.title: Evaluation of the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Efficacy of Subcutaneous Firsekibart in Gout: A Phase Ib/II Clinical Trial.
items.abstract: This Phase Ib/II study aimed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy of Firsekibart in the treatment of gout flares. Phase Ib part utilized an open-label, single-dose, dose-escalation design. Patients were enrolled and received a single subcutaneous injection of Firsekibart at a dose of 50, 100, or 195 mg. Phase II part was a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, parallel, positive-controlled study. Patients were assigned to receive either Firsekibart (100 or 195 mg) or Diprospan. As of June 9, 2022, a total of 120 patients (Phase Ib N = 29, Phase II N = 91) received the study drugs. In Phase Ib, Firsekibart demonstrated dose-dependent efficacy. Firsekibart 50 mg treatment provided less pain relief compared to the 100 mg and 195 mg. In Phase II, the visual analogue scale (VAS) score decreased by 5.51 ± 1.56, 4.72 ± 1.56 and 4.94 ± 2.44 cm after 72 h in Firsekibart 195 mg, 100 mg and Diprospan groups, respectively. Firsekibart 195 mg treatment showed a more effective pain relief trend. The pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of serum Firsekibart exhibits typical characteristics of monoclonal antibodies, featuring slow absorption (median T max approximately 5.9-6.9 days), limited distribution (distributed volume approximately 8.0-12.1 L) and slow elimination (clearance approximately 9.2-11.5 mL/h). Safety of Firsekibart was favorable and comparable across doses and relative to Diprospan. A single subcutaneous injection of Firsekibart is safe and well tolerated in the treatment of gout flares. It provides dose-dependent pain relief with favorable pharmacokinetic properties and potential for reducing the risk of gout flare recurrence. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05328531.

items.titleZh: 皮下注射Firsekibart在痛风中的安全性、耐受性、药代动力学和疗效评估：一项Ib/II期临床试验
items.abstractZh: 这项Ib/II期研究旨在评估Firsekibart治疗痛风发作的安全性、耐受性、药代动力学和疗效。Ib期部分采用开放标签、单剂量、剂量递增设计。患者入组并接受单次皮下注射Firsekibart，剂量为50、100或195 mg。II期部分是一项多中心、随机、双盲、平行、阳性对照研究。患者被分配接受Firsekibart（100或195 mg）或得宝松。截至2022年6月9日，共有120名患者（Ib期N=29，II期N=91）接受了研究药物。在Ib期，Firsekibart显示出剂量依赖性疗效。与100 mg和195 mg相比，Firsekibart 50 mg治疗提供的疼痛缓解较少。在II期，Firsekibart 195 mg组、100 mg组和得宝松组在72小时后的视觉模拟量表（VAS）评分分别下降了5.51±1.56、4.72±1.56和4.94±2.44 cm。Firsekibart 195 mg治疗显示出更有效的疼痛缓解趋势。血清Firsekibart的药代动力学（PK）特征表现出单克隆抗体的典型特征，包括缓慢吸收（中位Tmax约5.9-6.9天）、分布有限（分布容积约8.0-12.1 L）和缓慢消除（清除率约9.2-11.5 mL/h）。Firsekibart的安全性良好，且在各剂量组间以及与得宝松相比均相当。单次皮下注射Firsekibart在治疗痛风发作中是安全且耐受性良好的。它提供剂量依赖性的疼痛缓解，具有有利的药代动力学特性，并具有降低痛风发作复发风险的潜力。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05328531。

items.title: Neuro-Behçet's Disease and Psychiatric Disorders: From a Case Report to a Systematic Review.
items.abstract: Behçet's disease is a chronic, relapsing systemic vasculitis that can affect multiple organ systems. Neurological involvement, known as neuro-Behçet's disease, occurs in a subset of patients, while psychiatric manifestations-termed neuro-psycho Behçet's disease-remain poorly characterized. Understanding the clinical course, pathophysiology, and management of this condition is crucial for interdisciplinary care. To present a detailed case of a patient with neuro-psycho Behçet's disease and to explore its pathophysiology, clinical features, psychiatric symptoms, temporal progression, and therapeutic considerations. A clinical case of a 42-year-old male with neuro-Behçet's disease who developed a manic episode is described. Concurrently, a systematic review of published cases of neuro-psycho Behçet's disease was conducted using the Web of Science, PubMed, and Embase databases on July 19, 2024, following the criteria of the PRISMA-ScR Statement. The clinical case illustrates a multiphasic disease course, with systemic Behçet's disease symptoms preceding neurological and subsequently psychiatric manifestations. The systematic review included thirty-four cases, showing diverse psychiatric symptoms, including psychotic, affective, and behavioral disturbances. Neuroimaging frequently revealed parenchymal lesions correlating with psychiatric symptoms. Management typically combined immunosuppressive therapy for Behçet's disease with psychiatric treatment, including antipsychotic medications and mood stabilizers. Neuro-psycho Behçet's disease represents a clinically and pathophysiologically complex entity. The correlation between parenchymal lesions and psychiatric symptoms supports the hypothesis of a shared neurobiological substrate mediated by inflammatory and immunological mechanisms. A biphasic model, in which initial vascular involvement evolves into neurochemical and structural dysfunction, provides a coherent framework for understanding the relationship between Behçet's disease and psychiatric symptoms.

items.titleZh: 神经白塞病与精神障碍：从病例报告到系统综述
items.abstractZh: 白塞病是一种慢性、复发性系统性血管炎，可累及多个器官系统。神经系统受累（称为神经白塞病）发生于部分患者，而精神表现（称为神经精神白塞病）仍缺乏充分描述。了解该病的临床病程、病理生理学及管理对于跨学科护理至关重要。本文旨在报告一例神经精神白塞病患者的详细病例，并探讨其病理生理学、临床特征、精神症状、时间进展及治疗考虑。描述了一例42岁男性神经白塞病患者出现躁狂发作的临床病例。同时，于2024年7月19日按照PRISMA-ScR声明标准，在Web of Science、PubMed和Embase数据库中进行了已发表神经精神白塞病病例的系统综述。临床病例展示了多相病程，系统性白塞病症状先于神经系统表现，随后出现精神表现。系统综述纳入34例病例，显示多样化的精神症状，包括精神病性、情感性和行为障碍。神经影像学常显示与精神症状相关的实质病变。管理通常将白塞病的免疫抑制治疗与精神科治疗（包括抗精神病药物和心境稳定剂）相结合。神经精神白塞病在临床和病理生理学上是一个复杂的实体。实质病变与精神症状之间的相关性支持了由炎症和免疫机制介导的共享神经生物学底物的假说。双相模型（初始血管受累演变为神经化学和结构功能障碍）为理解白塞病与精神症状之间的关系提供了一个连贯的框架。

items.title: Post-transplant autoimmunity in a child: a lupus-like syndrome emerging in the context of chronic graft-versus-host disease.
items.abstract: Autoimmune manifestations are increasingly recognized as late complications following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), particularly in association with chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGvHD). However, the occurrence of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)-like features remains extremely rare, especially in pediatric patients. Understanding the mechanisms underlying such manifestations, including the role of mixed chimerism, is important for early recognition and management. We report the case of a girl with thalassemia major who underwent HSCT from a fully matched unrelated donor at the age of six years. Her early post-transplant course was complicated by gastrointestinal cGvHD, followed by autoimmune hemolytic anemia and arthritis, which responded to corticosteroids and methotrexate. Four years post-HSCT, she developed a lupus-like syndrome characterized by malar rash, serositis, cytopenias, arthritis, high-titer antinuclear antibodies (ANA), elevated anti-double-stranded DNA (anti-dsDNA) antibodies, and low complement levels, fulfilling the American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for SLE. At the time of symptom onset, mixed chimerism was documented, with a notable proportion of recipient-derived lymphocytes. Treatment with mycophenolate mofetil and hydroxychloroquine led to rapid clinical and laboratory improvement. This case illustrates the evolving nature of post-transplant immune dysregulation and suggests that declining donor chimerism may contribute to the reactivation of autoreactive lymphocytes, leading to atypical autoimmune manifestations. In pediatric patients presenting with unusual post-transplant symptoms, careful clinical assessment and immune monitoring may aid in timely diagnosis. Individualized immunosuppressive therapy can facilitate symptom control and support favorable long-term outcomes.

items.titleZh: 移植后自身免疫：一例儿童慢性移植物抗宿主病背景下出现的狼疮样综合征
items.abstractZh: 自身免疫表现逐渐被认为是造血干细胞移植（HSCT）后的晚期并发症，尤其与慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGvHD）相关。然而，系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）样特征的发生仍然极为罕见，尤其是在儿童患者中。了解此类表现的机制，包括混合嵌合体的作用，对于早期识别和管理至关重要。我们报告一例重型地中海贫血女孩，她在六岁时接受了来自完全匹配无关供者的HSCT。其移植后早期病程因胃肠道cGvHD而复杂化，随后出现自身免疫性溶血性贫血和关节炎，对皮质类固醇和甲氨蝶呤治疗有反应。移植后四年，她出现狼疮样综合征，特征为蝶形红斑、浆膜炎、血细胞减少、关节炎、高滴度抗核抗体（ANA）、升高的抗双链DNA（抗dsDNA）抗体和低补体水平，符合美国风湿病学会SLE分类标准。在症状出现时，记录到混合嵌合体，其中受体来源的淋巴细胞占显著比例。使用霉酚酸酯和羟氯喹治疗后，临床和实验室指标迅速改善。本病例说明了移植后免疫失调的演变性质，并提示供者嵌合体下降可能有助于自身反应性淋巴细胞的再激活，导致非典型自身免疫表现。对于出现移植后异常症状的儿童患者，仔细的临床评估和免疫监测可能有助于及时诊断。个体化的免疫抑制治疗可促进症状控制并支持良好的长期结局。

items.title: Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage As the Presenting Feature of Perinuclear Antineutrophil Cytoplasmic Antibody (p-ANCA)-Associated Vasculitis Preceded by Hearing Loss: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage (DAH) is a life-threatening pulmonary emergency that may occur as a manifestation of antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (AAV). We report a rare case of perinuclear antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (p-ANCA)-positive vasculitis presenting with severe DAH without renal involvement, preceded by acute bilateral hearing loss. A previously healthy 21-year-old woman presented with hemoptysis, severe hypoxemia, and respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation. Chest imaging showed bilateral diffuse infiltrates and ground-glass opacities. Bronchoalveolar lavage findings were consistent with DAH. Serologic workup revealed positive p-ANCA with negative cytoplasmic antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (c-ANCA) and anti-glomerular basement membrane (anti-GBM) antibodies. Renal function and urinalysis remained normal throughout admission. The patient was treated with pulse intravenous methylprednisolone followed by oral corticosteroids, leading to rapid clinical improvement and successful extubation within five days. Further history revealed bilateral hearing loss one week before presentation, which may represent a possible early otologic manifestation of vasculitis. This case highlights that ANCA-associated vasculitis may present as isolated DAH without renal involvement, while unexplained hearing loss may provide an early clue to underlying AAV before the onset of life-threatening pulmonary manifestations. Early recognition and prompt immunosuppressive therapy are essential to improve outcomes.

items.title: Anticoagulation-Amplified Recurrent Esophageal Hemorrhage in Triple-Positive Antiphospholipid Syndrome: The Inescapable Anticoagulation Dilemma.
items.abstract: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is an acquired thrombophilia. Triple-positive APS, defined by lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin, and anti-β2-glycoprotein I antibody positivity, usually requires long-term vitamin K antagonist therapy; direct oral anticoagulants are discouraged, and low-molecular-weight heparin is reserved for selected situations. A 52-year-old female with systemic lupus erythematosus and triple-positive APS on warfarin (International Normalized Ratio [INR] 2.9) presented with massive hematemesis requiring intubation. Serial esophagogastroduodenoscopy showed extensive esophageal clot burden followed by circumferential friability, sloughing, and necrotic/exudative esophagitis without varices or gastric/duodenal bleeding. Hemostatic powder was applied, fresh frozen plasma partially corrected the INR to 1.8, and anticoagulation was held. Therapeutic heparin bridging on hospital day 8 was followed by recurrent melena, hemoglobin decline from 8.3 to 5.5 g/dL, and gross hematuria; INR at rebleeding was 2.2. Hematology evaluation showed factor VIII activity 87% and negative Bethesda assay, arguing against acquired hemophilia A. Repeat endoscopy showed Los Angeles grade C esophagitis with clean-based linear ulcers and a 7-cm sliding hiatal hernia. Severe diffuse esophageal mucosal injury can cause recurrent major bleeding when anticoagulation is resumed before mucosal recovery. In high-risk APS, anticoagulation resumption should be individualized with hematology and gastroenterology input, and repeat endoscopy may help guide timing.

items.titleZh: 抗凝加剧的三阳性抗磷脂综合征复发性食管出血：不可避免的抗凝困境
items.abstractZh: 抗磷脂综合征（APS）是一种获得性易栓症。三阳性APS，定义为狼疮抗凝物、抗心磷脂抗体和抗β2-糖蛋白I抗体阳性，通常需要长期维生素K拮抗剂治疗；直接口服抗凝药不推荐，低分子肝素仅用于特定情况。一名52岁女性，患有系统性红斑狼疮和三阳性APS，服用华法林（国际标准化比值[INR] 2.9），出现大量呕血，需要插管。连续食管胃十二指肠镜检查显示广泛的食管血凝块，随后出现环周脆性、脱落和坏死/渗出性食管炎，无静脉曲张或胃/十二指肠出血。应用止血粉，新鲜冰冻血浆将INR部分纠正至1.8，并暂停抗凝。住院第8天开始治疗性肝素桥接后，出现反复黑便、血红蛋白从8.3 g/dL降至5.5 g/dL，以及肉眼血尿；再出血时INR为2.2。血液学评估显示因子VIII活性87%，Bethesda试验阴性，不支持获得性血友病A。重复内镜检查显示洛杉矶分级C级食管炎，基底干净的线性溃疡和7 cm滑动性食管裂孔疝。严重的弥漫性食管黏膜损伤可在黏膜恢复前恢复抗凝时导致反复大出血。在高危APS中，抗凝恢复应个体化，并咨询血液科和消化科，重复内镜检查可能有助于指导时机。
